hero.title: CRM
hero.subtitle: Streamline your customer relationships with AI-powered insights. Manage leads, track interactions, and grow revenue — all from one intelligent platform built for modern teams.

about.title: Built for the future of sales
about.desc: We started OurCRM with a simple premise: your customer data shouldn't be trapped in isolated silos. By combining industry-leading machine learning models with intuitive design, we help you foresee customer needs before they happen.
about.point2: SOC2 Type II Certified for enterprise-grade security

features.title: Everything you need to scale
features.desc: Powerful tools designed to help your team convert more leads, delight customers, and make smarter decisions.
features.leadMgmtDesc: Capture, score, and nurture leads through your pipeline. Automated workflows ensure no opportunity slips through the cracks.
features.customerInsightsDesc: Deep-dive into customer behavior and preferences. 360° profiles give your team the context they need to personalize every interaction.
features.aiAnalyticsDesc: Machine learning models predict churn, forecast revenue, and surface actionable insights — so you can act before problems arise.

implementation.title: Get up and running in days
implementation.desc: We handle the heavy lifting of importing your data and training your custom ML models. Here is our streamlined onboarding process.
implementation.step1Desc: Connect your existing tools with our one-click integrations or bulk import spreadsheets securely.
implementation.step2Desc: Our systems automatically clean your past data to train predictive algorithms specific to your pipelines.
implementation.step3Desc: Your team logs in to a fully populated, intelligent workspace ready to close deals on day one.
